title: Islaam pe ehsaan hai tera asghar e beshee
body:
Islaam pe ehsaan hai tera asghar e besheer
Kya na sahey zulm o jafa asgher e besheer
Wo nannhe se houto pe Qayamat ki tapish hayee
Maa kis tarha behlaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Is haal me bhi sabr kiya asgher e besheer
Bechain thi sab bibiyaan halat pe tumhari
Karti rahi zaree
Tha pyaas ka fir bhi na gila Asgher e besheer
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis waqt ke halmin ki sadaa kano me aayii
Lab par thi dohaee
Gehvare se nusrath ko chala asgher e besheer
Wo pyaase ro ro ke tera hichkiyaan lena
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhoole me tadapna
Bhulegi na maa haal tera asgher e besheer
Maidaan ko jate ho zara Thero meri jaan
Maa tum pa ho khurbaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Kurtaa toh badal du mai tera asgher e besheer
Batla mujhe jhule me mai ab kis ko jhulaoo
Kis ko mai sulaoon
Ajaye mujhe teri bala Asgher e besheer
<<DIVIDER>>
Marne ke abhi din bhi na the mannato wale
Akhon ke ujaale
Kya daag ye madar ko diya asgher e besheer
Aa nannhe tere pau me ghunru toh pinhalu
<<DIVIDER>>
jhule me jhulaa lu
De mujhko phir ek baar sadaa asgher e besheer
Veeran meri godh kiye aye mere dil bar
Maa hoti muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo kaise jiye ab ye bata asgher e besheer
Haaton pa liye laashe pisar aae jo sarwar
Tha karb ka manzar
Lab par thi sohail ek ye sada asgher e besheer
